claims.assertion: Mari defines a starseed as a soul with many incarnations in one extraterrestrial race that chooses brief human lives; a wanderer moves among races, while some souls reincarnate mostly as humans.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says all souls are starseeds broadly and leaves personal identification to each individual.

claims.assertion: Mari says souls are not formed on particular planets but are holographic fragments of an everywhere-present Source.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says Earth mixes beings of differing consciousness and vibration, bringing difficult interactions and potentially soul-nourishing experiences.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: Claims about soul withdrawal, illness, and reincarnation omitted
